item.title: REF 0.1.0
item.description:
• The first REF for Windows: drop in a reference and your mix and get the same numbers, match score and plain-English advice as REF on the Mac.
  • Play both level-matched and flip between them with R and M, with mono, side and the phase fix.
  • Live meters under the waveforms, or in their own window.
  • REF Send for your DAW (VST3), installed with REF: every pass you play lands in REF.
  • An early test, not signed yet: Windows asks you to approve it once.
